+# Local SQLite controller (ticket01)
+
+Standalone baseline; no PostgreSQL or Temporal dependency or service. Build and
+run from this directory, or pass `--manifest-path crates/sqlite-controller/Cargo.toml`.
+
+```sh
+cargo test --locked --offline --features fault-injection
+cargo build --locked --offline
+mkdir -m 700 /tmp/corenius-private
+# Set a retained random CORENIUS_OPERATOR_TOKEN through your secret handling.
+./target/debug/corenius-sqlite-controller /tmp/corenius-private/state.db /tmp/corenius-private/api.sock
+```
+
+The database directory must already exist on persistent supported local storage
+outside all worker mounts. Database, WAL, shared memory, socket and lifetime lock
+are controller-owned. The lock file is never removed; OS ownership ends on exit.
+Do not run the daemon with the `fault-injection` feature in normal operation.
+That explicit test build supports a pre-COMMIT admission barrier, not a runtime effect.
+
+Send one newline-delimited JSON request per Unix socket connection. Socket reading
+and response writing share a one-second total transport deadline; an expired
+connection closes. Retry an unacknowledged mutation with its original key. Replies are
+`{"ok": VALUE}` or `{"error": "DESCRIPTION"}`. The library exposes the same
+`Controller::open(path, bootstrap_secret)` and `Controller::handle(JSON)` seam.
+The operator principal is `operator`; the secret initializes it once and must
+match on reopen. No token rotation or historical-state import is implicit.
+
+```python
+import json, os, socket
+request = {
+    "auth": {"principal": "operator", "token": os.environ["CORENIUS_OPERATOR_TOKEN"]},
+    "project": "demo",
+    "command": {
+        "kind": "create_project", "expected_revision": 0,
+        "idempotency_key": "project-demo",
+        "args": {"name": "demo", "base": "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567"},
+    },
+}
+with socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX) as s:
+    s.connect("/tmp/corenius-private/api.sock")
+    s.sendall((json.dumps(request) + "\n").encode())
+    print(s.makefile().readline())
+```
+
+A command receipt contains `receipt`, `event_seq`, `revision`, and `result`.
+Use the returned project revision for the next mutation. Retry a lost response
+with the identical request and key; changing any argument or expected revision
+with that key is rejected. A conflict uses a new key and current revision.
+Authentication and current authority are checked before replay. Failed commands
+do not consume keys or append events. Keys are scoped by project, principal and
+authority epoch. JSON object field order does not affect identity.
+
+Replace `command` with `"query":{"kind":"snapshot","args":{}}` to inspect
+state. `events` accepts `after` (exclusive global sequence cursor) and `limit`
+(default100, maximum1000). Advance to the last event actually returned; gaps
+are normal across projects/scopes. Queries return only the authenticated scope.
+
+Commands and required arguments:
+
+| Command | Arguments | Authority |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `create_project` | `name`, `base` | operator |
+| `create_task` | `task`, `work_ref:{deployment,project,item}`, `source_revision`, `brief`; optional checked `brief_digest` | operator/lead |
+| `admit` | `task` | operator/lead |
+| `replace_lead` | `{}` | operator |
+| `pause_dispatch` | `paused` boolean | operator/lead |
+| `abort_task` | `task` | operator/lead |
+| `cancel_attempt` | `attempt` | operator/lead |
+| `observe_attempt` | `attempt`, `state`, `observation` | operator |
+| `transition_operation` | `operation`, `state`, `observation` | operator |
+| `ask_question` | `task`, `text` | operator/lead/own attempt |
+| `answer_question` | `question`, `text` | operator/lead |
+| `record_decision` | `text` | operator/lead |
+| `send_message` | `recipient` principal, `text` | scoped principal |
+| `ack_message` | `message` | recipient only |
+| `report_progress` | `task`, `text` | operator/lead/own attempt |
+
+Project base must be a full 40- or 64-hex Git commit OID, checked again at admission.
+Symbolic refs, abbreviations and malformed IDs are refused atomically. Object
+existence/retention belongs to ticket04.
+
+`admit` returns the attempt, slot, prepared start operation, pinned base/brief,
+and attempt principal/token/epoch. `replace_lead` returns a fresh lead grant;
+old lead grants fail immediately, while attempt authority stays independent.
+Token-bearing receipts stay private to their authenticated issuer.
+`dispatch_context` query (`attempt`) is operator-only and retrieves the retained
+current attempt grant for a future controller-owned adapter. `pending_operations`
+and `storage_configuration` queries are operator-only. Snapshots and events never
+expose grant tokens; attempts see their own tasks, questions, operations and
+sent/received messages. Message and acknowledgement events use retained sender/
+recipient identities, including acknowledgement replay to the original sender;
+caller task metadata never widens a message audience. Decisions are shared within the project.
+
+There are two slots across the entire controller. WorkRef is canonical per project, so aliases cannot double-admit the same work item.
+Admission pins immutable brief
+and source revision/digest and journals a start before acknowledgement. Dispatch
+is not implemented here. `prepared`, `applying`, and `unknown` operations survive
+restart for reconciliation; restart does not blindly dispatch or release slots.
+Cancellation records its own prepared operation, revokes the attempt grant, and
+retains capacity. Task abortion changes only task outcome. Only privileged
+`observe_attempt(state="exited")` releases a slot. Ticket02 must supply verified,
+identity-bound supervisor observations before issuing that command: an operator
+assertion in this storage fixture is not real process supervision proof.
+
+The supported operation transitions are prepared → applying/failed/unknown,
+applying → confirmed/failed/unknown, unknown → applying/confirmed/failed.
+Confirmed/failed are terminal. Observed attempts may move to running, unknown,
+or exited; exited is terminal. No operation outcome implies an attempt exited.
+Runtime effects must happen between separate journal commands, outside SQLite
+transactions. Future adapters must reconcile ambiguous starts before retrying.
+
+Version1 is a fresh-project migration applied atomically; unknown schema versions
+fail closed. Candidates, verification and acceptance have separate immutable
+schema records reserved for ticket04. No candidate/acceptance/landing command,
+artifact publication, backup/restore procedure, Kata or runtime adapter exists
+in01. Do not copy a live DB without its WAL, overwrite it with an older backup,
+or infer power-loss durability from process-kill tests. A supported restore path
+must add explicit authority rotation and external-effect reconciliation.

+//! A single local controller writer. All external participants use `handle` or the socket service.
+//! Runtime and Git effects belong outside this module's short transactions.
+use rusqlite::{Connection, OptionalExtension, Transaction, TransactionBehavior, params};
+use serde::Deserialize;
+use serde_json::{Value, json};
+use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
+use std::{
+    fs::{File, OpenOptions},
+    path::Path,
+    sync::Mutex,
+    time::Duration,
+};
+use uuid::Uuid;
+
+mod query;
+pub mod service;
+
+type Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, String>;
+fn db<T>(r: rusqlite::Result<T>) -> Result<T> {
+    r.map_err(|e| format!("storage: {e}"))
+}
+fn id() -> String {
+    Uuid::new_v4().to_string()
+}
+fn hash(s: &str) -> String {
+    format!("{:x}", Sha256::digest(s.as_bytes()))
+}
+fn text<'a>(v: &'a Value, field: &str) -> Result<&'a str> {
+    v.get(field)
+        .and_then(Value::as_str)
+        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty() && s.len() <= 65_536)
+        .ok_or_else(|| format!("invalid argument: {field}"))
+}
+
+#[derive(Deserialize)]
+#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
+struct Auth {
+    principal: String,
+    token: String,
+}
+#[derive(Deserialize)]
+#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
+struct Request {
+    auth: Auth,
+    project: String,
+    command: Option<Command>,
+    query: Option<Query>,
+}
+#[derive(Deserialize)]
+#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
+struct Command {
+    kind: String,
+    expected_revision: u64,
+    idempotency_key: String,
+    args: Value,
+}
+#[derive(Deserialize)]
+#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
+struct Query {
+    kind: String,
+    args: Value,
+}
+struct Principal {
+    id: String,
+    role: String,
+    epoch: i64,
+    attempt: Option<String>,
+    task: Option<String>,
+}
+
+pub struct Controller {
+    connection: Mutex<Connection>,
+    _ownership: File,
+}
+impl Controller {
+    /// Open a supported local database, locking its canonical pathname for this controller lifetime.
+    /// The bootstrap secret initializes the operator only on a fresh database; it never rotates it.
+    pub fn open(path: impl AsRef<Path>, bootstrap_token: &str) -> Result<Self> {
+        if bootstrap_token.len() < 12 {
+            return Err("bootstrap token must have at least 12 bytes".into());
+        }
+        let path = path.as_ref();
+        let parent = path
+            .parent()
+            .filter(|p| !p.as_os_str().is_empty())
+            .unwrap_or(Path::new("."));
+        let parent = parent
+            .canonicalize()
+            .map_err(|e| format!("database directory: {e}"))?;
+        let path = if path.exists() {
+            path.canonicalize().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
+        } else {
+            parent.join(path.file_name().ok_or("database filename required")?)
+        };
+        #[cfg(unix)]
+        {
+            use std::os::unix::fs::MetadataExt;
+            if path.exists() && path.metadata().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?.nlink() != 1 {
+                return Err("database hard links are unsupported".into());
+            }
+        }
+        let mut lock_path = path.as_os_str().to_os_string();
+        lock_path.push(".controller-lock");
+        let ownership =
+            private_file(Path::new(&lock_path)).map_err(|e| format!("ownership lock: {e}"))?;
+        ownership
+            .try_lock()
+            .map_err(|e| format!("controller ownership unavailable: {e}"))?;
+        drop(private_file(&path)?);
+        let mut connection = db(Connection::open(&path))?;
+        db(connection.busy_timeout(Duration::from_millis(500)))?;
+        db(connection.pragma_update(None, "journal_mode", "WAL"))?;
+        db(connection.pragma_update(None, "synchronous", "FULL"))?;
+        db(connection.pragma_update(None, "foreign_keys", "ON"))?;
+        let mode: String = db(connection.pragma_query_value(None, "journal_mode", |r| r.get(0)))?;
+        let sync: i64 = db(connection.pragma_query_value(None, "synchronous", |r| r.get(0)))?;
+        let fk: i64 = db(connection.pragma_query_value(None, "foreign_keys", |r| r.get(0)))?;
+        if mode != "wal" || sync != 2 || fk != 1 {
+            return Err("effective SQLite durability configuration refused".into());
+        }
+        let version: i64 = db(connection.pragma_query_value(None, "user_version", |r| r.get(0)))?;
+        if version == 0 {
+            let objects: i64 = db(connection.query_row(
+                "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_schema WHERE name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%'",
+                [],
+                |r| r.get(0),
+            ))?;
+            if objects != 0 {
+                return Err("fresh database required; unversioned foreign schema refused".into());
+            }
+            let tx = db(connection.transaction_with_behavior(TransactionBehavior::Immediate))?;
+            db(tx.execute_batch(include_str!("schema.sql")))?;
+            db(tx.execute("INSERT INTO principals(id,token_hash,role,epoch) VALUES('operator',?1,'operator',1)",[hash(bootstrap_token)]))?;
+            db(tx.commit())?;
+        } else if version != 1 {
+            return Err(format!(
+                "unsupported schema version {version}; explicit migration required"
+            ));
+        }
+        let stored: String = db(connection.query_row(
+            "SELECT token_hash FROM principals WHERE id='operator'",
+            [],
+            |r| r.get(0),
+        ))?;
+        if stored != hash(bootstrap_token) {
+            return Err("bootstrap secret does not match existing operator".into());
+        }
+        Ok(Self {
+            connection: Mutex::new(connection),
+            _ownership: ownership,
+        })
+    }
+
+    /// Authenticated JSON seam. A command returns a durable receipt only after COMMIT.
+    /// Queries authenticate before selecting any scoped state. Errors never create receipts.
+    pub fn handle(&self, request: Value) -> Result<Value> {
+        let request: Request =
+            serde_json::from_value(request).map_err(|e| format!("invalid request: {e}"))?;
+        if request.project.is_empty() || request.project.len() > 200 {
+            return Err("invalid project".into());
+        }
+        let mut connection = self
+            .connection
+            .lock()
+            .map_err(|_| "controller lock poisoned")?;
+        let principal = authenticate(&connection, &request.auth, &request.project)?;
+        match (request.command, request.query) {
+            (Some(command), None) => {
+                self.command(&mut connection, &principal, &request.project, command)
+            }
+            (None, Some(query)) => query::run(&connection, &principal, &request.project, query),
+            _ => Err("exactly one command or query required".into()),
+        }
+    }
+
+    fn command(
+        &self,
+        connection: &mut Connection,
+        p: &Principal,
+        project: &str,
+        c: Command,
+    ) -> Result<Value> {
+        if c.idempotency_key.is_empty() || c.idempotency_key.len() > 200 {
+            return Err("invalid idempotency key".into());
+        }
+        authorize(p, &c.kind, &c.args)?;
+        let arguments =
+            json!({"kind":c.kind,"expected_revision":c.expected_revision,"args":c.args})
+                .to_string();
+        let tx = db(connection.transaction_with_behavior(TransactionBehavior::Immediate))?;
+        let prior: Option<(String,String)> = db(tx.query_row("SELECT arguments,response FROM receipts WHERE project=?1 AND principal=?2 AND epoch=?3 AND key=?4",params![project,p.id,p.epoch,c.idempotency_key],|r|Ok((r.get(0)?,r.get(1)?))).optional())?;
+        if let Some((stored, receipt)) = prior {
+            if arguments != stored {
+                return Err("idempotency argument mismatch".into());
+            }
+            return serde_json::from_str(&receipt).map_err(|e| e.to_string());
+        }
+        let revision: i64 = db(tx
+            .query_row(
+                "SELECT revision FROM projects WHERE id=?1",
+                [project],
+                |r| r.get(0),
+            )
+            .optional())?
+        .unwrap_or(0);
+        if i64::try_from(c.expected_revision).ok() != Some(revision) {
+            return Err(format!(
+                "revision conflict: expected {}, current {revision}",
+                c.expected_revision
+            ));
+        }
+        if revision == 0 && c.kind != "create_project" {
+            return Err("project does not exist".into());
+        }
+        let result = apply(&tx, p, project, &c.kind, &c.args)?;
+        let next = revision.checked_add(1).ok_or("revision exhausted")?;
+        db(tx.execute(
+            "UPDATE projects SET revision=?2 WHERE id=?1",
+            params![project, next],
+        ))?;
+        let is_message = matches!(c.kind.as_str(), "send_message" | "ack_message");
+        // Message audiences come from the retained participant record, never caller task metadata.
+        let audience: Option<String> = if is_message {
+            let message = text(&result, "message")?;
+            let (sender, recipient): (String, String) = db(tx.query_row(
+                "SELECT sender,recipient FROM messages WHERE project=?1 AND id=?2",
+                params![project, message],
+                |r| Ok((r.get(0)?, r.get(1)?)),
+            ))?;
+            Some(if c.kind == "ack_message" {
+                sender
+            } else {
+                recipient
+            })
+        } else {
+            None
+        };
+        let task = if is_message {
+            None
+        } else {
+            c.args
+                .get("task")
+                .and_then(Value::as_str)
+                .or(p.task.as_deref())
+                .or_else(|| result.get("task").and_then(Value::as_str))
+        };
+        let event_body =
+            json!({"principal":p.id,"revision":next,"args":c.args,"result":public_result(&result)});
+        db(tx.execute(
+            "INSERT INTO events(project,task,audience,kind,body) VALUES(?1,?2,?3,?4,?5)",
+            params![project, task, audience, c.kind, event_body.to_string()],
+        ))?;
+        let seq = tx.last_insert_rowid();
+        let response = json!({"receipt":id(),"event_seq":seq,"revision":next,"result":result});
+        db(tx.execute("INSERT INTO receipts(project,principal,epoch,key,arguments,response) VALUES(?1,?2,?3,?4,?5,?6)",params![project,p.id,p.epoch,c.idempotency_key,arguments,response.to_string()]))?;
+        #[cfg(feature = "fault-injection")]
+        if c.kind == "admit"
+            && let Ok(marker) = std::env::var("CORENIUS_TEST_ADMISSION_BARRIER")
+        {
+            std::fs::write(marker, b"before commit").map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
+            loop {
+                std::thread::park();
+            }
+        }
+        db(tx.commit())?;
+        Ok(response)
+    }
+}
+
+fn authenticate(c: &Connection, auth: &Auth, project: &str) -> Result<Principal> {
+    type StoredPrincipal = (String, Option<String>, String, i64, Option<String>);
+    let row: Option<StoredPrincipal> = db(c
+        .query_row(
+            "SELECT token_hash,project,role,epoch,attempt FROM principals WHERE id=?1",
+            [&auth.principal],
+            |r| Ok((r.get(0)?, r.get(1)?, r.get(2)?, r.get(3)?, r.get(4)?)),
+        )
+        .optional())?;
+    let (digest, scope, role, epoch, attempt) = row.ok_or("authentication failed")?;
+    if digest != hash(&auth.token) {
+        return Err("authentication failed".into());
+    }
+    if role != "operator" && scope.as_deref() != Some(project) {
+        return Err("authorization: project scope".into());
+    }
+    let mut task = None;
+    if role == "lead" {
+        let current: i64 = db(c.query_row(
+            "SELECT lead_epoch FROM projects WHERE id=?1",
+            [project],
+            |r| r.get(0),
+        ))?;
+        if epoch != current {
+            return Err("authentication: superseded lead authority".into());
+        }
+    }
+    if role == "attempt" {
+        let (current, owned, state): (i64, String, String) = db(c.query_row(
+            "SELECT scope_epoch,task,state FROM attempts WHERE id=?1",
+            [attempt.as_deref().ok_or("authentication failed")?],
+            |r| Ok((r.get(0)?, r.get(1)?, r.get(2)?)),
+        ))?;
+        if current != epoch || state == "exited" {
+            return Err("authentication: revoked attempt authority".into());
+        }
+        task = Some(owned);
+    }
+    Ok(Principal {
+        id: auth.principal.clone(),
+        role,
+        epoch,
+        attempt,
+        task,
+    })
+}
+
+fn authorize(p: &Principal, kind: &str, args: &Value) -> Result<()> {
+    if matches!(
+        kind,
+        "create_project" | "replace_lead" | "observe_attempt" | "transition_operation"
+    ) && p.role != "operator"
+    {
+        return Err("authorization: operator required".into());
+    }
+    if p.role == "attempt" {
+        if !matches!(
+            kind,
+            "ask_question" | "send_message" | "ack_message" | "report_progress"
+        ) {
+            return Err("authorization: attempt command scope".into());
+        }
+        if matches!(kind, "ask_question" | "report_progress")
+            && Some(text(args, "task")?) != p.task.as_deref()
+        {
+            return Err("authorization: own task only".into());
+        }
+    }
+    Ok(())
+}
+fn public_result(result: &Value) -> Value {
+    let mut value = result.clone();
+    if let Some(object) = value.as_object_mut() {
+        object.remove("token");
+    }
+    value
+}
+
+fn apply(
+    tx: &Transaction<'_>,
+    p: &Principal,
+    project: &str,
+    kind: &str,
+    a: &Value,
+) -> Result<Value> {
+    match kind {
+        "create_project" => {
+            if text(a, "name")? != project {
+                return Err("project name mismatch".into());
+            }
+            db(tx.execute(
+                "INSERT INTO projects(id,base,revision) VALUES(?1,?2,1)",
+                params![project, commit_oid(text(a, "base")?)?],
+            ))?;
+            Ok(json!({"project":project}))
+        }
+        "create_task" => {
+            let task = text(a, "task")?;
+            let brief = id();
+            let body = text(a, "brief")?;
+            let wr = a.get("work_ref").ok_or("work_ref required")?;
+            for field in ["deployment", "project", "item"] {
+                text(wr, field)?;
+            }
+            let canonical_ref=json!({"deployment":text(wr,"deployment")?,"project":text(wr,"project")?,"item":text(wr,"item")?}).to_string();
+            let digest = hash(body);
+            if let Some(expected) = a.get("brief_digest")
+                && expected.as_str() != Some(&digest)
+            {
+                return Err("brief digest mismatch".into());
+            }
+            db(tx.execute("INSERT INTO briefs(id,project,task,work_ref,source_revision,body,digest) VALUES(?1,?2,?3,?4,?5,?6,?7)",params![brief,project,task,canonical_ref,text(a,"source_revision")?,body,digest]))?;
+            db(tx.execute(
+                "INSERT INTO tasks(project,id,brief,work_ref,state) VALUES(?1,?2,?3,?4,'created')",
+                params![project, task, brief, canonical_ref],
+            ))?;
+            Ok(json!({"task":task,"brief":brief,"brief_digest":digest}))
+        }
+        "admit" => {
+            let paused: bool = db(tx.query_row(
+                "SELECT paused FROM projects WHERE id=?1",
+                [project],
+                |r| r.get(0),
+            ))?;
+            if paused {
+                return Err("dispatch paused".into());
+            }
+            let task = text(a, "task")?;
+            let (state, brief): (String, String) = db(tx.query_row(
+                "SELECT state,brief FROM tasks WHERE project=?1 AND id=?2",
+                params![project, task],
+                |r| Ok((r.get(0)?, r.get(1)?)),
+            ))?;
+            if !matches!(
+                state.as_str(),
+                "created" | "repair-required" | "integration-required"
+            ) {
+                return Err("task is not eligible for admission".into());
+            }
+            let slot: Option<i64> = db(tx
+                .query_row(
+                    "SELECT id FROM slots WHERE attempt IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 1",
+                    [],
+                    |r| r.get(0),
+                )
+                .optional())?;
+            let slot = slot.ok_or("capacity: both worker slots occupied")?;
+            let attempt = id();
+            let operation = id();
+            let principal = format!("attempt:{attempt}");
+            let token = id();
+            let base: String = db(tx.query_row(
+                "SELECT base FROM projects WHERE id=?1",
+                [project],
+                |r| r.get(0),
+            ))?;
+            commit_oid(&base)?;
+            db(tx.execute("INSERT INTO attempts(id,project,task,brief,base,state) VALUES(?1,?2,?3,?4,?5,'starting')",params![attempt,project,task,brief,base]))?;
+            db(tx.execute(
+                "UPDATE slots SET attempt=?2 WHERE id=?1 AND attempt IS NULL",
+                params![slot, attempt],
+            ))?;
+            db(tx.execute(
+                "UPDATE tasks SET state='active' WHERE project=?1 AND id=?2",
+                params![project, task],
+            ))?;
+            db(tx.execute("INSERT INTO operations(id,project,attempt,kind,state,payload) VALUES(?1,?2,?3,'start','prepared',?4)",params![operation,project,attempt,json!({"attempt":attempt,"base":base,"brief":brief,"scope_epoch":1}).to_string()]))?;
+            db(tx.execute("INSERT INTO principals(id,token_hash,project,role,epoch,attempt) VALUES(?1,?2,?3,'attempt',1,?4)",params![principal,hash(&token),project,attempt]))?;
+            Ok(
+                json!({"attempt":attempt,"operation":operation,"slot":slot,"principal":principal,"token":token,"scope_epoch":1,"base":base,"brief":brief}),
+            )
+        }
+        "replace_lead" => {
+            db(tx.execute(
+                "UPDATE projects SET lead_epoch=lead_epoch+1 WHERE id=?1",
+                [project],
+            ))?;
+            let epoch: i64 = db(tx.query_row(
+                "SELECT lead_epoch FROM projects WHERE id=?1",
+                [project],
+                |r| r.get(0),
+            ))?;
+            let principal = format!("lead:{}", id());
+            let token = id();
+            db(tx.execute("INSERT INTO principals(id,token_hash,project,role,epoch) VALUES(?1,?2,?3,'lead',?4)",params![principal,hash(&token),project,epoch]))?;
+            Ok(json!({"principal":principal,"token":token,"role_epoch":epoch}))
+        }
+        "pause_dispatch" => {
+            let paused = a
+                .get("paused")
+                .and_then(Value::as_bool)
+                .ok_or("paused must be boolean")?;
+            db(tx.execute(
+                "UPDATE projects SET paused=?2 WHERE id=?1",
+                params![project, paused],
+            ))?;
+            Ok(json!({"paused":paused}))
+        }
+        "abort_task" => {
+            let task = text(a, "task")?;
+            let n=db(tx.execute("UPDATE tasks SET state='aborted' WHERE project=?1 AND id=?2 AND state NOT IN ('landed','accepted','aborted')",params![project,task]))?;
+            if n != 1 {
+                return Err("task cannot be aborted".into());
+            }
+            // Task outcome is independent of external execution lifetime and slot occupancy.
+            Ok(json!({"task":task}))
+        }
+        "cancel_attempt" => {
+            let attempt = text(a, "attempt")?;
+            require_attempt(tx, project, attempt)?;
+            let operation = id();
+            let n=db(tx.execute("UPDATE attempts SET cancel_requested=1,scope_epoch=scope_epoch+1 WHERE id=?1 AND state<>'exited' AND cancel_requested=0",[attempt]))?;
+            if n != 1 {
+                return Err("attempt cannot be cancelled".into());
+            }
+            db(tx.execute("INSERT INTO operations(id,project,attempt,kind,state,payload) VALUES(?1,?2,?3,'cancel','prepared',?4)",params![operation,project,attempt,json!({"attempt":attempt}).to_string()]))?;
+            Ok(json!({"attempt":attempt,"operation":operation,"cancel_requested":true}))
+        }
+        "observe_attempt" => {
+            let attempt = text(a, "attempt")?;
+            require_attempt(tx, project, attempt)?;
+            let state = text(a, "state")?;
+            let observation = text(a, "observation")?;
+            let old: String = db(tx.query_row(
+                "SELECT state FROM attempts WHERE id=?1",
+                [attempt],
+                |r| r.get(0),
+            ))?;
+            if old == "exited" || !matches!(state, "running" | "unknown" | "exited") {
+                return Err("invalid attempt transition".into());
+            }
+            db(tx.execute("UPDATE attempts SET state=?2,observation=?3,scope_epoch=scope_epoch+CASE WHEN ?2='exited' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE id=?1",params![attempt,state,observation]))?;
+            if state == "exited" {
+                db(tx.execute("UPDATE slots SET attempt=NULL WHERE attempt=?1", [attempt]))?;
+            }
+            Ok(json!({"attempt":attempt,"state":state}))
+        }
+        "transition_operation" => {
+            let operation = text(a, "operation")?;
+            let state = text(a, "state")?;
+            let old: String = db(tx.query_row(
+                "SELECT state FROM operations WHERE id=?1 AND project=?2",
+                params![operation, project],
+                |r| r.get(0),
+            ))?;
+            let allowed = match old.as_str() {
+                "prepared" => matches!(state, "applying" | "failed" | "unknown"),
+                "applying" => matches!(state, "confirmed" | "failed" | "unknown"),
+                "unknown" => matches!(state, "applying" | "confirmed" | "failed"),
+                _ => false,
+            };
+            if !allowed {
+                return Err("invalid operation transition".into());
+            }
+            db(tx.execute(
+                "UPDATE operations SET state=?2,observation=?3 WHERE id=?1",
+                params![operation, state, text(a, "observation")?],
+            ))?;
+            Ok(json!({"operation":operation,"state":state}))
+        }
+        "ask_question" => {
+            let question = id();
+            let task = text(a, "task")?;
+            db(tx.execute(
+                "INSERT INTO questions(id,project,task,sender,text) VALUES(?1,?2,?3,?4,?5)",
+                params![question, project, task, p.id, text(a, "text")?],
+            ))?;
+            Ok(json!({"question":question}))
+        }
+        "answer_question" => {
+            let question = text(a, "question")?;
+            let n=db(tx.execute("UPDATE questions SET answer=?3,answered_by=?4 WHERE project=?1 AND id=?2 AND answer IS NULL",params![project,question,text(a,"text")?,p.id]))?;
+            if n != 1 {
+                return Err("question missing or already answered".into());
+            }
+            let task: String = db(tx.query_row(
+                "SELECT task FROM questions WHERE id=?1",
+                [question],
+                |r| r.get(0),
+            ))?;
+            Ok(json!({"question":question,"task":task}))
+        }
+        "record_decision" => {
+            let decision = id();
+            db(tx.execute(
+                "INSERT INTO decisions(id,project,author,text) VALUES(?1,?2,?3,?4)",
+                params![decision, project, p.id, text(a, "text")?],
+            ))?;
+            Ok(json!({"decision":decision}))
+        }
+        "send_message" => {
+            let recipient = text(a, "recipient")?;
+            let scope: Option<Option<String>> = db(tx
+                .query_row(
+                    "SELECT project FROM principals WHERE id=?1",
+                    [recipient],
+                    |r| r.get(0),
+                )
+                .optional())?;
+            if !matches!(scope, Some(None))
+                && scope.as_ref().and_then(|s| s.as_deref()) != Some(project)
+            {
+                return Err("authorization: recipient project scope".into());
+            }
+            let message = id();
+            db(tx.execute(
+                "INSERT INTO messages(id,project,sender,recipient,text) VALUES(?1,?2,?3,?4,?5)",
+                params![message, project, p.id, recipient, text(a, "text")?],
+            ))?;
+            Ok(json!({"message":message}))
+        }
+        "ack_message" => {
+            let message = text(a, "message")?;
+            let n=db(tx.execute("UPDATE messages SET acknowledged=1 WHERE id=?1 AND project=?2 AND recipient=?3 AND acknowledged=0",params![message,project,p.id]))?;
+            if n != 1 {
+                return Err(
+                    "authorization: message missing, acknowledged, or wrong recipient".into(),
+                );
+            }
+            Ok(json!({"message":message}))
+        }
+        "report_progress" => Ok(json!({"task":text(a,"task")?,"text":text(a,"text")?})),
+        _ => Err(format!("unknown command: {kind}")),
+    }
+}
+fn require_attempt(tx: &Transaction<'_>, project: &str, attempt: &str) -> Result<()> {
+    let exists: bool = db(tx.query_row(
+        "SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM attempts WHERE project=?1 AND id=?2)",
+        params![project, attempt],
+        |r| r.get(0),
+    ))?;
+    if exists {
+        Ok(())
+    } else {
+        Err("attempt outside project or missing".into())
+    }
+}
+
+fn private_file(path: &Path) -> Result<File> {
+    use std::os::unix::fs::{OpenOptionsExt, PermissionsExt};
+    let file = OpenOptions::new()
+        .create(true)
+        .truncate(false)
+        .read(true)
+        .write(true)
+        .mode(0o600)
+        .open(path)
+        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
+    file.set_permissions(std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600))
+        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
+    Ok(file)
+}
+
+/// Validate an exact Git object identity. Repository object retention/lookup belongs to ticket04.
+fn commit_oid(value: &str) -> Result<&str> {
+    if !matches!(value.len(), 40 | 64) || !value.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_hexdigit()) {
+        return Err("invalid base: full 40- or 64-hex Git commit OID required".into());
+    }
+    Ok(value)
+}

+use super::*;
+use rusqlite::types::ValueRef;
+
+fn rows(c: &Connection, sql: &str, values: &[&dyn rusqlite::ToSql]) -> Result<Value> {
+    let mut stmt = db(c.prepare(sql))?;
+    let names: Vec<String> = stmt.column_names().into_iter().map(str::to_owned).collect();
+    let mapped = db(stmt.query_map(values, |row| {
+        let mut object = serde_json::Map::new();
+        for (i, name) in names.iter().enumerate() {
+            let v = match row.get_ref(i)? {
+                ValueRef::Null => Value::Null,
+                ValueRef::Integer(n)
+                    if matches!(
+                        name.as_str(),
+                        "acknowledged" | "cancel_requested" | "paused"
+                    ) =>
+                {
+                    json!(n != 0)
+                }
+                ValueRef::Integer(n) => json!(n),
+                ValueRef::Real(n) => json!(n),
+                ValueRef::Text(s) => json!(String::from_utf8_lossy(s)),
+                ValueRef::Blob(_) => Value::Null,
+            };
+            object.insert(name.clone(), v);
+        }
+        Ok(Value::Object(object))
+    }))?;
+    let values: Vec<Value> = db(mapped.collect())?;
+    Ok(Value::Array(values))
+}
+
+pub(super) fn run(c: &Connection, p: &Principal, project: &str, q: Query) -> Result<Value> {
+    match q.kind.as_str() {
+        "storage_configuration" => {
+            if p.role != "operator" {
+                return Err("authorization: operator required".into());
+            }
+            Ok(
+                json!({"journal_mode":db(c.pragma_query_value(None,"journal_mode",|r|r.get::<_,String>(0)))?,
+                "synchronous":db(c.pragma_query_value(None,"synchronous",|r|r.get::<_,i64>(0)))?,
+                "foreign_keys":db(c.pragma_query_value(None,"foreign_keys",|r|r.get::<_,i64>(0)))?,
+                "schema_version":db(c.pragma_query_value(None,"user_version",|r|r.get::<_,i64>(0)))?}),
+            )
+        }
+        "events" => {
+            let after = i64::try_from(q.args.get("after").and_then(Value::as_u64).unwrap_or(0))
+                .map_err(|_| "event cursor out of range")?;
+            let limit = q
+                .args
+                .get("limit")
+                .and_then(Value::as_u64)
+                .unwrap_or(100)
+                .clamp(1, 1000) as i64;
+            let task = p.task.as_deref();
+            let mut events = rows(
+                c,
+                "SELECT e.seq,e.task,e.kind,e.body FROM events e WHERE e.project=?1 AND e.seq>?2 AND (
+                    ?3 IS NULL OR
+                    (e.kind IN ('send_message','ack_message') AND EXISTS (
+                        SELECT 1 FROM messages m WHERE m.project=e.project
+                        AND m.id=json_extract(e.body,'$.result.message') AND (?4=m.sender OR ?4=m.recipient))) OR
+                    (e.kind NOT IN ('send_message','ack_message') AND
+                        (e.task=?3 OR e.audience=?4 OR e.kind IN ('record_decision','pause_dispatch')))
+                ) ORDER BY e.seq LIMIT ?5",
+                &[&project, &after, &task, &p.id, &limit],
+            )?;
+            for event in events.as_array_mut().unwrap() {
+                let raw = event["body"].as_str().unwrap();
+                event["body"] = serde_json::from_str(raw).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
+            }
+            Ok(events)
+        }
+        "dispatch_context" => {
+            if p.role != "operator" {
+                return Err("authorization: operator required".into());
+            }
+            let attempt = text(&q.args, "attempt")?;
+            let (epoch,state,cancel):(i64,String,bool)=db(c.query_row("SELECT scope_epoch,state,cancel_requested FROM attempts WHERE project=?1 AND id=?2",params![project,attempt],|r|Ok((r.get(0)?,r.get(1)?,r.get(2)?))))?;
+            if state == "exited" || cancel {
+                return Err("dispatch grant revoked".into());
+            }
+            let receipts = rows(
+                c,
+                "SELECT response FROM receipts WHERE project=?1 ORDER BY rowid",
+                &[&project],
+            )?;
+            for receipt in receipts.as_array().unwrap() {
+                let response: Value = serde_json::from_str(receipt["response"].as_str().unwrap())
+                    .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
+                let grant = &response["result"];
+                if grant["attempt"].as_str() == Some(attempt)
+                    && grant["scope_epoch"].as_i64() == Some(epoch)
+                    && grant["token"].is_string()
+                {
+                    return Ok(grant.clone());
+                }
+            }
+            Err("retained dispatch grant missing".into())
+        }
+        "pending_operations" => {
+            if p.role != "operator" {
+                return Err("authorization: operator required".into());
+            }
+            rows(
+                c,
+                "SELECT id,attempt,kind,state,payload,observation FROM operations WHERE project=?1 AND state IN ('prepared','applying','unknown') ORDER BY rowid",
+                &[&project],
+            )
+        }
+        "snapshot" => {
+            let mut project_row = rows(
+                c,
+                "SELECT id,base,revision,lead_epoch,paused FROM projects WHERE id=?1",
+                &[&project],
+            )?;
+            let project_row = project_row
+                .as_array_mut()
+                .unwrap()
+                .pop()
+                .ok_or("project missing")?;
+            let task = p.task.as_deref();
+            let attempt = p.attempt.as_deref();
+            let tasks = rows(
+                c,
+                "SELECT t.id,t.state,b.id AS brief,b.work_ref,b.source_revision,b.body,b.digest FROM tasks t JOIN briefs b ON t.brief=b.id WHERE t.project=?1 AND (?2 IS NULL OR t.id=?2) ORDER BY t.rowid",
+                &[&project, &task],
+            )?;
+            let attempts = rows(
+                c,
+                "SELECT id,task,brief,base,state,scope_epoch,cancel_requested,observation FROM attempts WHERE project=?1 AND (?2 IS NULL OR id=?2) ORDER BY rowid",
+                &[&project, &attempt],
+            )?;
+            let operations = rows(
+                c,
+                "SELECT id,attempt,kind,state,payload,observation FROM operations WHERE project=?1 AND (?2 IS NULL OR attempt=?2) ORDER BY rowid",
+                &[&project, &attempt],
+            )?;
+            let questions = rows(
+                c,
+                "SELECT id,task,sender,text,answer,answered_by FROM questions WHERE project=?1 AND (?2 IS NULL OR task=?2) ORDER BY rowid",
+                &[&project, &task],
+            )?;
+            let worker = (p.role == "attempt").then_some(p.id.as_str());
+            let messages = rows(
+                c,
+                "SELECT id,sender,recipient,text,acknowledged FROM messages WHERE project=?1 AND (?2 IS NULL OR sender=?2 OR recipient=?2) ORDER BY rowid",
+                &[&project, &worker],
+            )?;
+            let decisions = rows(
+                c,
+                "SELECT id,author,text FROM decisions WHERE project=?1 ORDER BY rowid",
+                &[&project],
+            )?;
+            let occupied: i64 = db(c.query_row(
+                "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM slots WHERE attempt IS NOT NULL",
+                [],
+                |r| r.get(0),
+            ))?;
+            Ok(
+                json!({"project":project_row,"revision":project_row["revision"],"occupied_slots":occupied,"tasks":tasks,"attempts":attempts,"operations":operations,"questions":questions,"messages":messages,"decisions":decisions}),
+            )
+        }
+        _ => Err(format!("unknown query: {}", q.kind)),
+    }
+}

+-- Fresh-project schema v1. No import from another backend.
+CREATE TABLE projects (
+ id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, base TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision >= 1),
+ lead_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, paused INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(paused IN (0,1))
+);
+CREATE TABLE briefs (
+ id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, project TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id), task TEXT NOT NULL,
+ work_ref TEXT NOT NULL, source_revision TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, digest TEXT NOT NULL
+);
+CREATE TABLE tasks (
+ project TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id), id TEXT NOT NULL, brief TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES briefs(id), work_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
+ state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('created','active','submitted','repair-required','integration-required','accepted','landed','aborted')),
+ PRIMARY KEY(project,id), UNIQUE(project,work_ref)
+);
+CREATE TABLE attempts (
+ id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, project TEXT NOT NULL, task TEXT NOT NULL, brief TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES briefs(id), base TEXT NOT NULL,
+ state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('starting','running','exited','unknown')), scope_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
+ cancel_requested INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(cancel_requested IN (0,1)), observation TEXT,
+ FOREIGN KEY(project,task) REFERENCES tasks(project,id)
+);
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_live_task ON attempts(project,task) WHERE state <> 'exited';
+-- Two slots for the controller, not two per project. Unknown executions retain these rows.
+CREATE TABLE slots (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id IN (1,2)), attempt TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES attempts(id));
+INSERT INTO slots(id) VALUES (1),(2);
+CREATE TABLE principals (
+ id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, token_hash TEXT NOT NULL, project TEXT REFERENCES projects(id),
+ role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('operator','lead','attempt')), epoch INTEGER NOT NULL,
+ attempt TEXT REFERENCES attempts(id)
+);
+CREATE TABLE operations (
+ id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, project TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id), attempt TEXT REFERENCES attempts(id),
+ kind TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('prepared','applying','confirmed','failed','unknown')),
+ payload TEXT NOT NULL, observation TEXT
+);
+CREATE TABLE events (
+ seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, project TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id),
+ task TEXT, audience TEXT, kind TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL
+);
+CREATE TABLE receipts (
+ project TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id), principal TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES principals(id), epoch INTEGER NOT NULL,
+ key TEXT NOT NULL, arguments TEXT NOT NULL, response TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(project,principal,epoch,key)
+);
+CREATE TABLE questions (

+//! One newline-delimited JSON request per local connection; workers never open SQLite.
+use crate::Controller;
+use serde_json::json;
+use std::{
+    fs,
+    io::{Read, Write},
+    os::unix::{
+        fs::{FileTypeExt, PermissionsExt},
+        net::{UnixListener, UnixStream},
+    },
+    path::Path,
+    time::{Duration, Instant},
+};
+const MAX_REQUEST: usize = 1_048_576;
+const REQUEST_DEADLINE: Duration = Duration::from_secs(1);
+
+/// Serve until process shutdown. A stale socket may be removed only after proving no listener.
+/// Keep the socket and database directory outside worker mounts.
+pub fn serve(controller: Controller, socket: impl AsRef<Path>) -> Result<(), String> {
+    let socket = socket.as_ref();
+    if let Ok(metadata) = fs::symlink_metadata(socket) {
+        if !metadata.file_type().is_socket() {
+            return Err("socket path exists and is not a socket".into());
+        }
+        match UnixStream::connect(socket) {
+            Ok(_) => return Err("socket already has a live listener".into()),
+            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::ConnectionRefused => {
+                fs::remove_file(socket).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
+            }
+            Err(e) => return Err(format!("cannot establish stale socket: {e}")),
+        }
+    }
+    let listener = UnixListener::bind(socket).map_err(|e| format!("socket bind: {e}"))?;
+    fs::set_permissions(socket, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
+    for stream in listener.incoming() {
+        let stream = stream.map_err(|e| format!("socket accept: {e}"))?;
+        if let Err(e) = serve_request(&controller, stream) {
+            eprintln!("connection: {e}");
+        }
+    }
+    Ok(())
+}
+fn serve_request(controller: &Controller, mut stream: UnixStream) -> Result<(), String> {
+    let deadline = Instant::now() + REQUEST_DEADLINE;
+    let response = match read_request(&mut stream, deadline) {
+        Ok(None) => return Ok(()),
+        Err(error) => json!({"error":error}),
+        Ok(Some(bytes)) => match serde_json::from_slice(&bytes) {
+            Ok(request) => match controller.handle(request) {
+                Ok(value) => json!({"ok":value}),
+                Err(error) => json!({"error":error}),
+            },
+            Err(_) => json!({"error":"invalid JSON"}),
+        },
+    };
+    let bytes = format!("{response}\n").into_bytes();
+    let mut offset = 0;
+    while offset < bytes.len() {
+        stream
+            .set_write_timeout(Some(remaining(deadline)?))
+            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
+        let n = stream.write(&bytes[offset..]).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
+        if n == 0 {
+            return Err("response transport closed".into());
+        }
+        offset += n;
+    }
+    Ok(())
+}
+fn remaining(deadline: Instant) -> Result<Duration, String> {
+    deadline
+        .checked_duration_since(Instant::now())
+        .filter(|d| !d.is_zero())
+        .ok_or_else(|| "whole request deadline exceeded".into())
+}
+fn read_request(stream: &mut UnixStream, deadline: Instant) -> Result<Option<Vec<u8>>, String> {
+    let mut bytes = Vec::new();
+    let mut buffer = [0u8; 8192];
+    loop {
+        stream
+            .set_read_timeout(Some(remaining(deadline)?))
+            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
+        let n = stream
+            .read(&mut buffer)
+            .map_err(|e| format!("request read deadline or transport error: {e}"))?;
+        if n == 0 {
+            return if bytes.is_empty() {
+                Ok(None)
+            } else {
+                Err("request framing limit".into())
+            };
+        }
+        if let Some(end) = buffer[..n].iter().position(|b| *b == b'\n') {
+            bytes.extend_from_slice(&buffer[..=end]);
+            if bytes.len() > MAX_REQUEST {
+                return Err("request size limit".into());
+            }
+            return Ok(Some(bytes));
+        }
+        bytes.extend_from_slice(&buffer[..n]);
+        if bytes.len() > MAX_REQUEST {
+            return Err("request size limit".into());
+        }
+    }
+}

+# Ticket01 author handoff
+
+Route: approved gated baseline; Matt owner unavailable, repository crosswalk
+applied with TDD and verification skills. Root owns independent Standards/Spec
+and branch gates; ticket remains claimed, not resolved. No downstream adapter,
+provider, Git landing, Kata, dashboard or historical import was implemented.
+
+Original assignment base: cf52c11055be09298e6ecc1353e5901e45726551.
+Integration base: 55bb58b344c44990f527b7bfb61947702fbe5445 (root-authorized doc-only
+fast-forward before the first source commit). Worktree: corenius-sqlite01-storage;
+branch: sqlite01/storage. Legacy source/evidence is untouched.
+
+Public API and examples: [crate README](../../../../../crates/sqlite-controller/README.md).
+Standalone crate owns its lockfile and pins rusqlite0.38.0 with bundled SQLite.
+`Controller::handle(Value)` and the Unix socket daemon share authentication,
+authority/revision guards, commands, projections, receipts and events. The API
+uses JSON envelopes, command project revisions and scoped idempotency; downstream
+participants must never open this database. Error descriptions currently use
+stable categories in text, not a versioned machine error-code enum.
+
+Storage/authority contract:
+
+- One lifetime OS file lock at the canonical DB pathname plus `.controller-lock`;
+  persistent lock file, no stale PID reclamation. Every controller connection
+  validates WAL, synchronous FULL, foreign keys; busy timeout is500ms. A mutex
+  serializes commands; immediate short transactions end before any external effect.
+- Two globally shared slots, unique live task attempts. Admission commits task,
+  slot, attempt, immutable brief/base link, prepared start, grant, event and receipt
+  together. Task abortion/cancel/unknown outcomes retain unresolved capacity.
+  Observed exit is privileged and revokes grant/releases slot atomically.
+- Operator is deployment-wide; leads and attempts are project scoped. Lead
+  `RoleEpoch` and attempt `ScopeEpoch` are independent. Auth/current epoch precede
+  receipt lookup. Idempotency tuple is project/principal/epoch/key; canonical JSON
+  arguments include command kind, expected revision and all arguments.
+- Canonical WorkRef uniqueness prevents alias tasks. Source WorkRef + exact source revision + computed SHA256 UTF-8 brief digest are
+  pinned at task creation. Brief, event, decision and future candidate/evidence/
+  acceptance records are append-only. Candidate identity includes commit/tree/base/
+  report digest. Future commands must bind verification and acceptance to one
+  exact candidate; physical landing must journal expected base and retained lineage.
+- Messages retain sender/recipient/ack; questions retain answer/author; decisions
+  retain author. Event sequence is global and reconnect cursors may contain gaps.
+  Worker projections are scoped; event bodies redact grant tokens. Only operator
+  `dispatch_context(attempt)` returns the retained current credential. `pending_operations`
+  provides the durable local dispatch/reconciliation queue; notifications are hints.
+
+Ticket02 should extend this deep seam with identity-bound execution and cleanup
+records/commands and enforce reconciliation before dispatch. Never infer observed
+termination from abort, cancel, failed operation, lease, missing acknowledgement,
+or controller restart. `observe_attempt` currently accepts privileged fixture
+observations; no supervisor or real execution guarantee is claimed. Ticket03 uses
+supported Kata APIs and adds journaled synchronization; ticket04 adds immutable
+candidate/evidence/acceptance commands and expected-base landing operations.
+Ticket05 consumes the same command/event seam and durable projections. Candidate
+storage tables are reserved; their admission and artifact-content validation are
+not yet exposed and must be implemented/proven by their owning ticket.
+
+Qualification limits: real on-disk local SQLite/process tests, no paid/live models;
+no power-loss/storage-fault proof, network filesystem support, backup rollback
+detection or supported restore. An unannounced manual older-DB replacement cannot
+be detected here. No automatic schema import or restore is available. Normal
+binary excludes fault injection; the explicit test feature alone enables the
+pre-COMMIT marker/barrier used by the independently controlling kill test.
+
+Evidence logs include behavioral RED/GREEN, final verification, and honestly
+classified setup failures. The initial network Cargo fetch timed out on native
+binding downloads and was terminated (status143); direct bounded crate downloads
+populated Cargo's normal cache, verified by Cargo lockfile checksums on offline
+build. `setup-compile.log` is an implementation compile failure (unsigned SQL
+integers corrected), not behavioral RED. Source digests and final command/status
+are recorded in `tested-source.json` and `verification.txt`.
